name: Volume-Slicing Lattice Rendering
definition: A real-time volumetric rendering method that represents fire as a lattice of hexahedral volumes along parametric flame curves, rendered via shader fragments with trilinear interpolation to merge flame elements visually.
summary: Volume-Slicing Lattice Rendering is a real-time method that approximates fire as a hexahedral lattice along parametric curves, using shader acceleration to merge elements visually.
